recommendation: Keep the empty audit commit as-is. No core follow-up is needed for FHIR-5851 unless a future work group decision reopens the broader ELD-11 bindable-type policy.
issue_request: FHIR-5851 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core change request asking to update the ElementDefinition binding human description after the formal rule had been generalized to support string; its resolution says to add string in SVN revision 4611.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 6dc4494b702f8adfa8accd9c0632ea8e6f440547 imported SVN build revision 4611 and changed source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml from "Binding can only be present for coded elements" to "Binding can only be present for coded elements, and string" while the expression included string.
additional_context: ElementDefinition is active and normative in source/fhir.ini, while DataElement is commented out as a current resource. Later same-invariant decisions and commits intentionally broadened the rule: c932c0fb84da434a50f6dd78ecd29316c4466d82 added uri, FHIR-30085 added Duration, and FHIR-21622 scoped ELD-11 to FHIR-defined types. Community searches found no directly relevant conflicting discussion for FHIR-5851.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source/datatypes/elementdefinition.xml ELD-11 row already says binding is allowed for coded elements, string, and uri when using FHIR-defined types, and the formal expressions still include string.
